text.en: For risotto, do not rinse the rice; coat the grains in hot butter or oil before the liquid goes in.
text.de: Für Risotto den Reis nicht waschen; die Körner in heißer Butter oder heißem Öl überziehen, bevor die Flüssigkeit zugegeben wird.

why.en: Rinsing removes the starch that gives the dish its creamy consistency.
why.de: Waschen entfernt die Stärke, die dem Gericht seine cremige Konsistenz gibt.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 5 Grains, section 5.2 Purchasing, Storing and Cooking Grains, Risotto
sources.sentence: The grains are not rinsed before cooking, as this removes the starches needed to achieve the desired consistency.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 5 Grains, section 5.2 Purchasing, Storing and Cooking Grains, Risotto
sources.sentence: The grains are coated, but not cooked, in a hot fat such as butter or oil.
